frequency_question: How often does the regulatory authority activate the countercyclical capital buffer (or equivalent dormant macroprudential capital buffer) when economic conditions technically warrant it according to framework guidelines?
membership_rule: Includes any jurisdiction with a formalized Basel III/IV countercyclical capital buffer framework operating under a mandate to cycle it. Excludes jurisdictions without such a framework or where the buffer is already set above zero.

coverage_note: 6 named successful activations; 1 notable persistent holdout (US Federal Reserve) under structurally identical friction parameters.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller emerging market jurisdictions with non-standard banking system structures.
skeleton: Global adoption of CCyB frameworks across advanced economies where macroprudential committees had the structural authority to activate the buffer from 0%
multiplier: 6 historical successful activation jurisdictions divided by 7 major jurisdictions with active frameworks that reached conditions warranting consideration
validity_reason: The structural friction remains constant until the regulatory mandate or institutional voting dynamics undergo formal legislative reform.
